summary: Pick a KPI to chart it and list its top rows, with one range for all.
intent: Block: the top of a dashboard. A Scoreboard of three or four KPIs that is also the picker, a LineChart of the picked KPI, a DataTable of the top rows behind it, and one range control (SegmentedControl) that changes all of them.
useWhen: the first row of an analytics or reporting dashboard
compare a few KPIs and drill into one without leaving the page
one range (7 / 30 / 90 days) should change cards, chart and table together
doNotUseWhen: only a strip of numbers: Scoreboard
one chart on its own: LineChart or BarChart
a full dataset to search and filter: DataTable
more than four KPIs: Scoreboard with Conveyor

metrics.note: 3–4 of { id, label, values: Record<range, { value, delta?, trend?, deltaTone? }>, columns: DataTableColumn[], rowsTitle?, rankBy? }. Values are pre-formatted strings; a range with no entry shows a dash.

series.note: series[metricId][range]: ChartDatum[] ({ label, value }) for the LineChart.

rows.note: rows[metricId][range]: DataTableRow[] (each with id). Ranked by the metric's rankBy column, highest first, then cut to rowLimit.

ranges.note: { value, label }[], two to four, e.g. 7d / 30d / 90d.

defaultRange.note: Uncontrolled starting range. Default the first.

selectedMetric.note: Controlled metric id for the chart and table.

defaultSelectedMetric.note: Uncontrolled starting metric. Default the first.

rowLimit.note: How many top rows the table shows.

layout: top: heading beside the range SegmentedControl
then the Scoreboard of KPIs, one row
then the LineChart beside the DataTable, in layout-split--primary
the block is its own inline-size container; below --grid-breakpoint-md (64rem) of block width the table stacks under the chart

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
the range is a kit SegmentedControl (radio group) named Range
each KPI is a Scorecard button with aria-pressed; the selected one shows an In chart badge and its name includes it
the chart title and the table caption name the metric and the range
the LineChart keeps its table view; the DataTable keeps its caption and scroll region
no motion of its own; the parts' motion is transform and opacity and off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not rebuild KpiBoard from a local dashboard; import the block
Do not add a second range control; the one range drives cards, chart and table
Do not put more than four KPIs in it
No solid primary Button in the block; leave it to the page
snippet: <KpiBoard metrics={metrics} series={series} rows={rows} ranges={[{ value: "7d", label: "7 days" }, { value: "30d", label: "30 days" }, { value: "90d", label: "90 days" }]} defaultRange="30d" />
